title: About Us — Eddie Would Go
units: Who we are and how we work.
“Eddie would go” is what Hawaiian surfers say when the ocean turns impossible.

Eddie Aikau was a lifeguard at Waimea Bay who paddled into waves no one else dared to face. That's where the name comes from, and the way we work: there's little merit in understanding the world when it's calm. We care about the moment a strait closes, a government falls, or the price of something nobody was watching suddenly spikes.

EWG is independent geopolitical intelligence, written in Spanish from Argentina. We're there when power is decided: in elections, in crises, in the negotiations that redraw the map. We follow events as they happen, cross-check them against data, and explain them with depth and without noise.
